conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service. This is Officer Mark Reynolds, badge number IR-782516. Who am I speaking with?
Uh, hello, my name is Ravi Patel. I got a message saying something about my business taxes, and I'm very worried.

Mr. Patel, I need to confirm your full legal name and the business entity you operate. The IRS has flagged your account for non-compliance regarding federal payroll tax filings and 1099 submissions. Can you verify your business name and your registered address?
Yes, my business is Patel Web Solutions, and my address is 42 Elm Street, apartment 5C, Houston, Texas, 77019.

Thank you for confirming. According to IRS Section 6721, your business has failed to report required payroll taxes and has multiple unfiled 1099 forms for recent quarters. This is a federal violation.
I, I didn't know. I thought I filed everything. Is my visa in trouble because of this?

You are currently under federal audit, and this non-compliance could result in immediate asset seizure, freezing of your bank accounts, and a formal report to U.S. immigration authorities. Your work authorization and visa status may be revoked.
No, please, I didn't mean to do anything wrong. How can I fix this? I need to stay here for my job.

There is a legally mandated Recovery Payment that must be processed today to halt escalation. Any delay will trigger court summons, penalties exceeding $25,000, and referral to DHS for removal proceedings. Do you understand the seriousness?
Yes, I understand. What do I need to do now?
First, I need to verify your Social Security Number and Employer Identification Number. Provide those now so I can confirm your file matches our records.
My SSN is 123-45-6789, and the EIN is 12-3456789.

Thank you. Now, per IRS emergency payment protocol, you are required to make a compliance payment of $6,450 today via approved payment channels. We do not accept credit card or bank transfer for flagged accounts. You must use either Bitcoin or prepaid gift cards for audit tracking.
Bitcoin? I don't have that. I don't understand how to do this.

Listen carefully. This is not negotiable. If you cannot process Bitcoin, then you must immediately purchase prepaid Target or Apple gift cards totaling $6,450. Do not tell anyone the cards are for the IRS, or your case will be flagged for intentional obstruction.
Okay... I can try. Should I go now?

Yes. Stay on this line while you go to the nearest store. Do not hang up or put me on hold. Once you purchase the cards, return to your car and read me the codes from the back of each card. If you disconnect, the IRS enforcement division will be alerted.
Alright, I'm leaving now. I'm so scared. Please, I'm not going to get deported, right?
That depends on your cooperation. The only way to avoid asset seizure and immigration referral is to follow directions precisely. Do not speak to anyone at the store about this transaction.
Okay, I'm almost at the store. Is it okay if I use multiple cards? I don't think they let me buy that much at once.
Yes, you may split the amount across several cards. Ensure the total is $6,450. After purchase, scratch off the silver strip and read every code to me immediately.
Alright, I have the cards now. I got four $500 Target cards and some Apple cards for the rest.
Good. Now, starting with the Target cards, read me the card number and pin from the back of each card, one at a time. Speak clearly.
Okay, the first Target card is 1234 5678 9012 3456, pin 7890. The next one is...
Continue reading all the codes. Do not skip any. Once finished, I will confirm the payment and issue your compliance certificate.
Alright, I finished reading all the codes. What happens now?
Remain on the line. I am processing your payment. If there are any discrepancies, you may be required to purchase additional cards. Failure to comply will result in immediate escalation.
